business_summary: Bafang Electric (Suzhou) Co.,Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of e-mobility components and complete e-drive systems for e-bikes, e-scooters or for public bike-sharing schemes in China and internationally. The company offers front, mid, and rear motors; gear hub products; HMI products, including LCD and LED; and intube, downtube, and rack type batteries. In addition, the company offers Bafang Go app which is connected for cycling journey with remote control, real-time tracking, personalized settings, and navigation. Further, its products are used in eMTB, eRoad, eTour, eCity, eCargo, eFat fields. Bafang Electric (Suzhou) Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2003 and is headquartered in Suzhou, China.
